title: Adaptive path correction as a label-free severe-sparsity guardrail
claim: Against SynFlow and magnitude on Fashion-MNIST MLP/CNN, adaptive path correction is most valuable at the severe sparsity cliff. It is not always best at 90-95%, but at 98% it beats both baselines in every paired case currently tested.

primary_result.setting: Fashion-MNIST MLP and CNN, SynFlow/magnitude baselines, 90/95/98% sparsity, two seeds each

what_it_is_not: Not evidence for the original branching-ratio criticality mechanism.
Not a universal replacement for magnitude pruning.
Not yet validated on large CNNs, transformers, or production-scale datasets.
